name: The Devil
general: Attachments, unconscious patterns, temptation, and desire.
love: Intense bonds that can become possessive or dependent.
career: Strong ambition that's worth watching to avoid excess.
shadow: Being tied to habits or relationships that limit freedom.
gift: The ability to recognise and transform one's own attachments.

positions.puntoE: When Arcana 15 occupies your Point E, your comfort zone can be, without you fully noticing, tied to certain attachments or patterns that feel familiar even when they don't always serve you: intense relationships, pleasurable habits, or forms of security that, deep down, limit your real freedom. You feel comfortable in the known, even when that known comes at a cost. The risk is not noticing the tie precisely because it feels like comfort. Learning to tell apart what you truly choose from what you simply repeat out of habit is your task from this point.
positions.colaKarmica: When Arcana 15 appears in your karmic tail, it suggests that in inherited patterns you got caught up in dependencies — emotional, material, or behavioural — that repeated themselves without being fully conscious. This life invites you to heal that pattern: to learn to look your own attachments in the eye, with honesty and without excessive guilt, so you can choose with real freedom instead of repeating automatically. It's common to feel that certain patterns keep coming back in different forms, and recognising them — without judging yourself harshly — is the first step toward transforming them.
positions.lineaDinero: If Arcana 15 sits in your money line, your relationship with prosperity can be marked by a strong ambition that, well channelled, drives you remarkably, but which without awareness can lead to excess: working too much, competing unfairly, or depending on money as your main source of emotional security. The typical block is an attachment-based relationship with money itself, whether by accumulating it compulsively or spending it as a way to fill a void. Learning to relate to prosperity from freedom, not from need, tends to heal this energy.
positions.lineaMasculina: In your masculine or paternal line, Arcana 15 brings an intense, at times possessive energy: it can reflect a paternal figure with strong ambitions or with patterns of dependency — on work, on a substance, on a form of control — that shaped the family dynamic. If that inheritance was lived out of balance, you may have sensed possessiveness or rigidity tied to that figure's desires. Your task is to recognise these inherited patterns with honesty, so you can consciously choose which ones to keep and which to let go of.
positions.lineaFemenina: In your feminine or maternal line, Arcana 15 expresses itself as an intense energy, at times tied to patterns that are hard to name: it can reflect a maternal figure with possessive or dependent bonds, whose love mixed with a certain degree of control. In its less balanced form, this may have felt like suffocating bonds or guilt used as a tool for closeness. Recognising this pattern lets you love without repeating the tie, telling apart the genuine inherited care from the control that sometimes came with it.
